            valueType: 'DateTime',
            labelFormat: 'yyyy', // Format to show only year
            intervalType: 'Years',
            edgeLabelPlacement: 'Shift',
            title: 'Year',
            minimum: new Date(1980, 0, 1), // Start from 1970
            maximum: new Date(2020, 0, 1), // End at 2020
            majorTickLines: { width: 0 },
            minorTickLines: { width: 0 },
            interval: 4,
            labelIntersectAction: Browser.isDevice ? 'Rotate90': 'Rotate45'
        },
        primaryYAxis: {
            title: 'Sales(Units)',
            labelFormat: '{value}',
            lineStyle: { width: 0 },
            minimum: 0,
            maximum: 100,
            interval: 20,
            majorTickLines: { width: 0 }
        },
        series: [{
            dataSource: chartData,
            xName: 'x',
            yName: 'y',
            type: 'StepArea',
            name: 'Product Sales',
            opacity: 0.1,
            border: { width: 2.5 },
            noRisers: true,
            step: 'Center',
            marker:{allowHighlight:false}
        }],
        title: 'Sales of Product Over Time',
        chartArea: { border: { width: 1 } },
        tooltip: {
            enable: true, shared: true
        },

        width: Browser.isDevice ? '100%' : '75%',
        load: (args: ILoadedEventArgs) => {
            let selectedTheme: string = location.hash.split('/')[1];
            selectedTheme = selectedTheme ? selectedTheme : 'Fluent2';
            args.chart.theme = <ChartTheme>(selectedTheme.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
                selectedTheme.slice(1)).replace(/-dark/i, 'Dark').replace(/contrast/i, 'Contrast').replace(/-highContrast/i, 'HighContrast');
        }
    });
    chart.appendTo('#container');
